propositions: LLM step call failures are non-fatal by design and swallowed at ~13 sites across src/rebar/llm/, each logging a warning but contributing nothing visible to the plan-review verdict JSON
An overlap[] or other aggregate result that is empty because every LLM call failed is byte-identical to one that is empty because nothing overlapped, making silent degradation invisible to callers
Failed LLM calls already funnel through a single seam at PydanticAIRunner.run:573 which records to JSONL spend logs but not into any in-memory verdict counter
The plan-review verdict has no survived-failure counter: coverage.resolution_class fires only on fatal degradation, and coverage.chunk_errors is write-only with no reader

A run-scoped contextvar-based sink must record failures at the runner seam and drain them into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving byte-identity and attestation-safety for clean runs
The drained shape is {total: <int>, by_step: {<call_label>: <int>}} keyed by runner._call_label verbatim, and the text renderer _render_plan_review_text must print the count when present
